app.name: OrderPilot
app.tagline: AI reads, rules decide, people approve.

shell.uploadHint: Demo: let Spark read a sample PO
shell.sparkHint: Demo: ask Spark about stock or sales

shortcuts.palette: Search or jump to a page, order or record
shortcuts.close: Close a panel, menu or dialog
shortcuts.undo: Undo the last change that offers Undo
shortcuts.search: Search the list on this page
shortcuts.save: Save the form you are editing
shortcuts.confirm: Confirm a dialog that asks for a reason

notes.search: Works on pages that have a search box.
notes.new: Works on pages that have a New button.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.description: Search for an order, customer, vendor, item, page or action.
palette.placeholder: Search orders, customers, vendors, items or pages
palette.emptyRecords: No order, customer, vendor or item matches "{{query}}". Try an order or PO number.
palette.searching: Searching orders, customers, vendors and items
palette.failedTrace: Could not search the records. Trace id {{traceId}}.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.noInbox: Your role has no task inbox, so there is nothing to remind you about.

set.FOCUSING: Focusing for {{hours}} hours. Reminders and approvals still reach you.
set.DO_NOT_DISTURB: Do not disturb for {{hours}} hours. Reminders and approvals still reach you.

menu.label: Your availability
menu.hint: Reminders and approvals still reach you. It goes back to Available after {{hours}} hours.

demo.switcherHint: Switch to another role. An order on screen stays open for a role that may read orders, and each role keeps its own open records.

switchAsk.title: Switch role?
switchAsk.body: Anything on this page that is not saved may be lost.

jobs.SUPPORT: Takes in the customer's order and sends the proforma invoice
jobs.PRODUCT_MANAGER: Watches stock and run rate, and raises the request to buy
jobs.APPROVER: Approves or rejects the request to buy
jobs.WAREHOUSE: Packs the goods and checks them against the papers
jobs.LOGISTICS: Books the forwarder and follows the shipping papers
jobs.MANAGEMENT: Reads the tracker and the KPIs

errors.network: OrderPilot could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.contract: The server sent an answer this version of the app does not understand.

codes.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some of the details are not valid.
codes.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is not right.
codes.REFRESH_REUSED: Your session was closed for your safety. Sign in again.
codes.FORBIDDEN: You do not have access to this.
codes.CSRF_INVALID: The request could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.
codes.DEMO_MODE_DISABLED: The demo sign-in is switched off.
codes.CONFLICT: Someone else changed this first. Reload and try again.
codes.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
codes.UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: A connected system is not answering. Try again soon.
codes.INTERNAL_ERROR: The server had a problem. Try again, and quote the trace ID if it continues.
codes.TWO_STEP_REQUIRED: Enter the code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
codes.TWO_STEP_CHALLENGE_ENDED: This sign-in has ended. Enter your email and password again.
codes.TWO_STEP_CODE_INVALID: That code did not work. Wait for the next code and try again. If it keeps failing, check that your phone's clock is set automatically.
codes.TWO_STEP_LOCKED: Too many wrong codes. Wait a while, or use a recovery code.
codes.TWO_STEP_SETUP_ENDED: The setup ended. Start again to get a new key.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you asked for does not exist or has moved.
notFound.addressHint: Check it for a typing slip, or open a place from the panel.

forbidden.title: You do not have access
forbidden.description: Your role does not include this area. If you think it should, ask a system admin.
forbidden.notForRole: This area is not part of the {{role}} role. A system admin can change what a role may open.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.description: This page hit an error. Quote the trace ID if you ask for help.
crash.reference: The team can find exactly what happened from this trace ID.
